verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a code review feature ("Access to Cloud agent and code review") and Autofix providing contextual vulnerability explanations, indicating Copilot can review PRs and offer contextual feedback, but there's no evidence of it being automatic on every PR by default, nor independent/hands-on confirmation of its quality or coverage. missing for 10: details on automatic triggering per PR, breadth/depth of review feedback, and independent validation of review quality.
